claims: C1 a conversation is a valid input to the model
C2 a conversation consists of a list of messages
C3 every message in a conversation contains a role
C4 every message in a conversation contains content

concepts.name: conversation_definition
concepts.gloss: C is a conversation: a valid input to the model structured as an ordered list of messages

concepts.name: message_in_conversation
concepts.gloss: message M is an element of conversation C

ontology.body: message_in_conversation(C, M), message_role(M, R), message_content(M, X)
ontology.gloss: C is a conversation: a valid input consisting of a list of messages each with a role and content
